record.method: Independent line-by-line mathematical read of all twenty-one proof blocks and comparison of literal supplier scopes; no Lean replay.
checks: LTP1 actual span/intersection YOf and injective finite scalarizations include empty coefficient spaces.
LTP2 actual split section and commuting complementary factors, plus integrality at the conjugate place without a split premise.
LTP3–9 isotypy via actual global irreducibility and finite separating equivariant maps; no extra nonzero or type-openness assumption for IsoL/IsoQ.
LTP10 retains coefficient matrix in UQ fixed equation; LTP11 transfers original unnormalized spherical sums for every natural j.
LTP12 treats nonsplit outside places directly by local-support subgroup and the same nonzero scalarization.
LTP13–14 CM embedding injectivity, dual highest weight and the same fixed iota are checked; no continuity of iota.
LTP15 preserves literal depth-one Kc(1); LTP16–18 product type section, arbitrary individually isotypic module, every supplied Teichmuller family and every original IsRecT.
LTP19 actual smooth admissible component is constructed from positive form and ADP finite multiplicity, with nonzero evaluation map and rank-zero case.
LTP20 fixed vectors go both ways for every component; LTP21 makes one simultaneous choice before all consumers.
remaining_boundaries: ADP/ITA and their named foundations are retained at original scope.
No Galois decoration or whole selected-leaf closure is inferred from this packet.

dependency_convention: depends_on contains only numbered human claims. No foundation label is inserted as a fake DAG claim. Inherited foundation records are named separately above.
